ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_Prospec.en:
Hey, there!
How's it going?\pWhat am I doing here, you ask?
Why, I'm prospecting for gold!\pWhen I strike it rich, I'm buying
a house in KANTO.
ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_Prospec.fr: Hé toi ! Comment ça va ?\pTu veux savoir ce que je fais ? Je\nsuis chercheur d'or.\pQuand je serai riche, j'achèterai\nune maison à KANTO.

ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_StruckG.en:
Hey, there! How's it going?
Did you hear? I've struck gold!\pYou remembered that I was
prospecting, didn't you?\pYou can't begin to imagine just
how happy I am.\pSo, I'll show you!
This is for you!
ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_StruckG.fr: Hé toi ! Comment ça va ?\pT'es au courant ? J'ai trouvé de\nl'or ! Tu peux pas t'imaginer\pcomme je suis heureux.\pAllez, prends ça, ça me fait\nplaisir !

ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ThatsAN.en: That's a NUGGET!\pI can't give you any nuggets of\nwisdom, so that'll have to do!
ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ThatsAN.fr: C'est une PÉPITE.\pTu verras, ça vaut du pognon !

ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_WhoopsB.en: Whoops, your BAG is crammed full!\nI'll give this to you later.
ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_WhoopsB.fr: Crotte, ton SAC est plein ! Je te\nla donnerai une autre fois.
